payload.claim: The Problem section's span-format rule states that `spans` joins each construct's `first-last` by `", "`, in line order, with `first` alone when the two are equal. That sub-rule (a single-line construct, such as a one-line `def f(): return x` or `class C: pass`) is never exercised by any fixture attached to criterion 1 or any other criterion; every construct the `mod/lib.py` fixture produces spans two or more lines. A build that always emitted `first-last` even when `first == last` would still pass the declared witness `test_citation_defects_judge_a_citation_by_the_construct_its_clause_names`, since this sub-rule is not restated in the criterion's own `claim` text and only appears as Problem-section implementer guidance.
